2317-5256-7084-8345.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.

4316-4460-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

147-3085-4050.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3085-4050.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2841-7705-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-7705-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Mole Man and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Mole Man trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

618-728-3742.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Phantom Steed.
When the Phantom Steed token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Phantom Steed token.
When the Phantom Steed token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1170-2921-5131-7692--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2921-5131-7692--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Shuri.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

277-1308-4094-6441-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-1308-4094-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

225-4094-6441-6753-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-4094-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

372-4863-7431.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Daydream exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-4863-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Revolutionist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Revolutionist trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Daydream.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Revolutionist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2034-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Repeat from step 4.

206-222-527-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-3259-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
1115-3259-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1115-3259-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Hammer of Purphoros so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

2034-3000-5220-6351-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-3000-5220-6351-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Teval triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

3490-4369-5231-5905.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4369-5231-5905.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Warleader's Call triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Warleader's Call triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Warleader's Call triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4871-5496-7057-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Nightscape Familiar.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4359-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2793-5089-6459-6797.description:
If Karn has exactly one loyalty counter on it, activate its first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus will be exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Aetheric Amplifier by paying {4} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat from step 2.

780-2974-4871.description:
Cast Repository Skaab by paying {3}{U}.
When Repository Skaab enters, its exploit ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Supernatural Stamina by paying {B}, targeting Repository Skaab.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, causing it to exploit itself. Pitiless Plunderer, Repository Skaab's second ability and Repository Skaab's ability gained from Supernatural Stamina trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the first Repository Skaab trigger, returning Supernatural Stamina from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Repository Skaab trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

628-4050-6672.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrifiicing Bloodied Ghost.
When Bloodied Ghost dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. When it enters, Bloodied Ghost will put a -1/-1 counter on itself, removing the +1/+1 counter.
Repeat.

851-2043-4050-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {2}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

1486-1744-2719-2972.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Ganax.
When the Ganax tokens enter the battlefield, each Ganax triggers five times, creating 25 Treasure tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for a Dragon card and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, each Ganax triggers, creating six Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3 until you have no Dragons remaining in your library.
1486-1744-2719-2972.notes: This combo will make some extra Treasures which you may use to activate Magda's ability a few extra times to fetch a few artifacts.

1789-4050-4875-5649.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-4050-4875-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

437-509-1781-3094-4131.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
437-509-1781-3094-4131.description:
Activate Thran Forge by paying {2}, causing Sphinx's Disciple to get +1/+0 and to become an artifact until end of turn.
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 6.

1039-3358-5075.notablePrerequisites:
Hell's Caretaker does not have summoning sickness.
It is your upkeep step.
1039-3358-5075.description:
During your upkeep, activate Teardrop Kami by sacrificing it, targeting Hell's Caretaker.
When Teardrop Kami dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping it and sacrificing the Rat, returning Teardrop Kami from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1651-3263-4024-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Humans.
1651-3263-4024-4659.description:
Activate Horn of Gondor by paying {3} and tapping it, creating at least three 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Human Soldiers, untapping Horn of Gondor.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Human Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

225-539-3177-3257.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

1261-4067.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untap Time Vault.
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

914-5105-5256.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-5105-5256.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}{R}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dockside Extortionist's power.
Repeat.
